description: Files 2000-2013 contain only deaths that occurred and were registered in the file year. From 2014, files are by registration year and include late registrations of earlier deaths.
Code 90 = Exterior in 2000-2003 (label in 2003; canton 0). From 2004, 88 = Exterior and 90 = Zonas no delimitadas.
88 Exterior appears; 90 now means Zonas no delimitadas (cantons 1-4).
Provinces 23 Santo Domingo de los Tsachilas and 24 Santa Elena first used. Before: cantons 1706, 0917, 0926, 0915. See geo_changes.csv.
La Concordia moves from zona no delimitada (9002) to Esmeraldas (0808).
causa4 introduced. 2000-2007 cause is built from causa+causa1 or codcausa.
Coded variables stored as 2-character text ("01", "99") in 2011 only. Canton becomes 4-digit DPA.
Periferica category no longer used.
Lugar de ocurrencia expands from 6 to 7 categories (Junta de Beneficencia separated). Harmonized by collapsing 3+4.
Missing age sentinel changes from 99 to 999. Ages above 99 recorded from 2013; before, the top value is 99 and ages >= 98 heap there.
La Concordia moves from Esmeraldas (0808) to Santo Domingo (2302).
Age 0 hours allowed (< 1 hour).
Canton and parish of residence dropped. Residence is province-level only from 2015.
Zonas no delimitadas no longer used.
Variable label wrongly says "Anio de nacimiento"; values are years of death.
Code 90 = Exterior (canton 00). No separate code for zonas no delimitadas.
50 = Zonas no delimitadas, 90 = Exterior (labels in 2002-2003). Canton within 50 not identifiable.
Canton of the establishment first available.
88 = Exterior, 90 = Zonas no delimitadas from 2004.
Age in years top-coded at 98 in 2004-2012 (labels "1 a 98"); 99 in 2000-2003. Open-ended from 2013.
Provinces 23 and 24 first used; see geo_changes.csv.
Explicit discharge year from 2013. Before, the statistical year is used (equal by design).
La Concordia moves from Esmeraldas (0808) to Santo Domingo (2302).
Age unit recoded: 2000-2014 1 dias, 2 meses, 3 anios, 9 ignorado; 2015+ 1 horas, 2 dias, 3 meses, 4 anios, 9 sin informacion. Same code, different meaning: never pool raw codes.
Area of residence first available.
Sex 3 Indeterminado appears (1-5 records a year).
Diagnosis codes with a 5th character appear (S and M chapters). icd10 keeps 4.
Zonas no delimitadas no longer used.
